variables.name: NODE_ENV
variables.description: Runtime environment; development, test, or production.

variables.name: LOG_LEVEL
variables.description: Minimum emitted severity; log fields remain allowlisted at every level.

variables.name: SERVICE_VERSION
variables.description: Deployed version identifier, such as a commit SHA or release tag.

variables.name: API_PORT
variables.description: API TCP port, an integer from 1 through 65535.

variables.name: API_LISTEN_ADDRESS
variables.description: Optional IPv4 or IPv6 bind address; omission uses 127.0.0.1 in development/test and 0.0.0.0 in production.

variables.name: COBUDGET_FIELD_ENCRYPTION_PROVIDER
variables.description: S4 field-encryption key provider. "local" for development; "kms" once CBD-120 delivers a client.

variables.name: COBUDGET_FIELD_ENCRYPTION_LOCAL_KEY
variables.description: Base64-encoded 32-byte AES-256 key for the local field-encryption provider. Required when the provider is "local"; refused outside NODE_ENV=development/test.

variables.name: COBUDGET_FIELD_ENCRYPTION_KEY_VERSION
variables.description: Key version recorded on ciphertext written by the local provider. Required when the provider is "local".

variables.name: CONFLUENCE_BASE_URL
variables.description: HTTPS site origin only; no credentials, path, query, fragment, or explicit port.

variables.name: CONFLUENCE_EMAIL
variables.description: Operator email for repository tooling; required only when this tool runs.

variables.name: CONFLUENCE_API_TOKEN
variables.description: Secret API token; fill only in the untracked environment, never commit a value.

variables.name: JIRA_BASE_URL
variables.description: HTTPS site origin only; no credentials, path, query, fragment, or explicit port.

variables.name: JIRA_EMAIL
variables.description: Operator email for repository tooling; required only when this tool runs.

variables.name: JIRA_API_TOKEN
variables.description: Secret API token; fill only in the untracked environment, never commit a value.

variables.name: GH_TOKEN
variables.source: read-only GitHub workflow token, checkpoint step only
variables.description: Ephemeral read-only token to recover successful publication history; never used for Confluence writes.

variables.name: COBUDGET_DB_PORT
variables.source: environment, then untracked .env.local, then local-only default
variables.description: Loopback host port for the local PostgreSQL container.

variables.name: COBUDGET_DB_NAME
variables.source: environment, then untracked .env.local, then local-only default
variables.description: Database created by the local PostgreSQL container.

variables.name: COBUDGET_DB_SUPERUSER
variables.source: environment, then untracked .env.local, then local-only default
variables.description: Bootstrap superuser for the loopback-only local PostgreSQL container.

variables.name: COBUDGET_DB_SUPERUSER_PASSWORD
variables.source: environment, then untracked .env.local, then local-only default
variables.description: Non-secret bootstrap password for the loopback-only local PostgreSQL container.

variables.name: COBUDGET_DB_MIGRATION_PASSWORD
variables.source: environment, then untracked .env.local, then local-only default
variables.description: Non-secret local password for the migration role.

variables.name: COBUDGET_DB_API_PASSWORD
variables.source: environment, then untracked .env.local, then local-only default
variables.description: Non-secret local password for the API role.

variables.name: COBUDGET_DB_WORKER_PASSWORD
variables.source: environment, then untracked .env.local, then local-only default
variables.description: Non-secret local password for the worker role.

variables.name: CI
variables.description: CI runner signal. Platform-owned, not application configuration.

variables.name: SCARF_ANALYTICS
variables.description: Dependency-install analytics disabled by CI policy; not a deployable setting.

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Subprocess-only time-zone override proving deterministic date arithmetic.

variables.name: COBUDGET_SESSION_PEPPER
variables.description: Base64-encoded server-side pepper (>= 32 bytes) for session verifier and CSRF digests (CBD-191 SC-191-001). Never stored in the database. Required under the local identity provider.

variables.name: COBUDGET_SESSION_IDLE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
variables.description: Idle session expiry in seconds (CBD-191 section 5.1). Required under the local identity provider.

variables.name: COBUDGET_SESSION_ABSOLUTE_LIFETIME_SECONDS
variables.description: Absolute session lifetime in seconds (CBD-191 section 5.1). Required under the local identity provider.

variables.name: COBUDGET_SESSION_FRESH_ASSURANCE_WINDOW_SECONDS
variables.description: Fresh-assurance validity window in seconds (CBD-191 section 5.1). Required under the local identity provider.

variables.name: COBUDGET_SESSION_REVOCATION_PROPAGATION_TARGET_SECONDS
variables.description: Revocation propagation deadline in seconds (CBD-191 section 6.1). Required under the local identity provider.

variables.name: COBUDGET_SESSION_PROVIDER_MAX_FUTURE_SKEW_SECONDS
variables.description: Maximum accepted future skew of a provider event time in seconds (CBD-191 section 6.2). Required under the local identity provider.

variables.name: COBUDGET_SESSION_REJECTION_TIMING_FLOOR_MS
variables.description: Minimum response bucket for a session rejection in milliseconds (CBD-191 SC-191-001A). Required under the local identity provider.

variables.name: COBUDGET_SESSION_REJECTION_TIMING_JITTER_MS
variables.description: Random jitter added to a session rejection in milliseconds (CBD-191 SC-191-001A). Required under the local identity provider.

variables.name: COBUDGET_SESSION_REJECTION_TIMING_SAMPLE_COUNT
variables.description: Minimum sample count for the rejection-timing differential test (CBD-191 CT-191-002A). Required under the local identity provider.

variables.name: COBUDGET_SESSION_REJECTION_TIMING_TIMEOUT_BUCKET_MS
variables.description: Response bucket used when the session store times out, in milliseconds (CBD-191 SC-191-001A). Required under the local identity provider.

variables.name: COBUDGET_SESSION_REJECTION_TIMING_MAX_DIFFERENTIAL_MS
variables.description: Maximum permitted timing differential between rejection classes in milliseconds (CBD-191 CT-191-002A). Required under the local identity provider.

variables.name: COBUDGET_SESSION_ENVELOPE_KEY_PROVIDER
variables.description: Delivery-envelope key provider for sealed session delivery results (CBD-191 section 3.1). "local" is refused outside NODE_ENV=development/test; "kms" is not yet available.

variables.name: COBUDGET_SESSION_ENVELOPE_KEY
variables.description: Base64-encoded 32-byte key for the local delivery-envelope provider. Required when the envelope provider is "local". Separate custody from the session pepper and the field-encryption key.

variables.name: COBUDGET_SESSION_ENVELOPE_KEY_VERSION
variables.description: Key version recorded on sealed delivery envelopes. Required when the envelope provider is "local".

variables.name: COBUDGET_IDENTITY_PROVIDER
variables.description: Identity adapter. "local" is the Cognito-shaped local adapter (development/test only); "cognito" stays refused until PROVIDERS-LOCAL-001 is superseded; "unavailable" (or absent) starts the API with the fail-closed authorization boundary and no sign-in.

variables.name: COBUDGET_IDENTITY_ENVIRONMENT_ID
variables.description: Identity environment row (CBD-190 section 3). Must equal NODE_ENV under the local adapter; a cross-environment value fails startup.

variables.name: COBUDGET_IDENTITY_ISSUER
variables.description: Exact OIDC issuer. Under the local adapter it must be the ceremony origin plus /v1/identity/local, on loopback.

variables.name: COBUDGET_IDENTITY_CLIENT_ID
variables.description: Exact OAuth client identifier the adapter sends and requires in the ID token audience. Not a secret; the client is public (PKCE only).

variables.name: COBUDGET_IDENTITY_APPLICATION_ORIGIN
variables.description: The one allowed initiating application origin (scheme://host[:port]). Callbacks navigate back to it; sign-in and logout requests must carry it as their Origin.

variables.name: COBUDGET_IDENTITY_CEREMONY_ORIGIN
variables.description: Origin that serves the hosted ceremony. Must differ from the application origin (CBD-190 section 8); the local adapter serves it from the API origin.

variables.name: COBUDGET_IDENTITY_CALLBACK_URI
variables.description: Exact provider-registered callback URI; its path must be /v1/identity/callback. No prefix, suffix, query or fragment matching.

variables.name: COBUDGET_IDENTITY_CHALLENGE_LIFETIME_SECONDS
variables.description: Lifetime of a begin challenge (state, PKCE, nonce). Required under the local adapter.

variables.name: COBUDGET_IDENTITY_EXCHANGE_LIFETIME_MS
variables.description: Maximum lifetime of one bounded token exchange, including issuer revocation (CBD-190 section 10.1). Required under the local adapter.

variables.name: COBUDGET_IDENTITY_MAPPING_MAX_ATTEMPTS
variables.description: Maximum whole-transaction attempts for the identity mapping (CBD-190 section 5.2). Required under the local adapter.

variables.name: COBUDGET_IDENTITY_HANDOFF_LIFETIME_SECONDS
variables.description: Lifetime of a prepared session hand-off before it becomes terminal (CBD-190 section 6). Required under the local adapter.

variables.name: COBUDGET_IDENTITY_CLOCK_SKEW_SECONDS
variables.description: Accepted clock skew for provider token times (CBD-190 section 4.3). Required under the local adapter.
